prompt: I want to build a new app from this messy product corpus. Take me through the product rules, one rendered surface at a time, implementation, and verified release.
Rebuild this app across onboarding, home, and the decision workspace without losing my taste between mocks and code.
Resume the multi-session app build from its state file and design log, verify current production truth, then continue from the next unpassed gate.
Turn these prototypes and contradictory notes into a coherent product, then build the smallest end-to-end slice.
required_behavior: separate doctrine history and current truth

prompt: Design the mobile and desktop experiences as different connected surfaces, get my approval on each, then implement them.
Take the existing product through discovery, product-corpus alignment, mock-driven redesign, build, and live verification.
Use the app-building method I liked on CTRL: lock the rule, show me one real mock, wait for my reaction, then systemize and ship.
required_behavior: promote recurring fixes to the system

prompt: Help me turn this venture idea into a working MVP, but surface the product forks only I can decide and keep driving through everything else.
required_behavior: ask one consequential question at a time

prompt: Several product surfaces were built by different agents and no longer cohere. Re-establish the product rules, design floor, and verified delivery path.
required_behavior: reconcile rather than add a competing source

prompt: Fix the failing TypeScript unit test in the billing service and do not touch the UI.
reason: An isolated implementation repair does not need app-delivery orchestration.

prompt: Implement the button component from the mock I already approved and run its tests.
reason: Routine implementation inside a locked design routes directly to the build owner.

prompt: Audit the deployed app on mobile and desktop and report reproducible UX issues. Do not change anything.
reason: Diagnosis-only UX testing is owned by the validator.

prompt: Design a two-page sales PDF for Mindmaker.
reason: A non-app visual artifact does not need the app-delivery lifecycle.

prompt: Replace the stale sentence in this already approved onboarding card.
reason: A bounded content correction inside a locked surface is not a multi-stage app journey.

prompt: Research the current alternatives to Supabase for this product and recommend one.
reason: Research and architecture recommendation before a final build route do not invoke delivery orchestration.

prompt: Add the approved index and RLS policy to this migration, then parse the SQL.
reason: A bounded backend change stays with the implementation owner.

prompt: Create one standalone campaign landing page from this finished brief.
reason: One specified marketing artifact does not justify the stateful app-delivery orchestrator.

prompt: This is a new app. Build all six screens before showing me anything so we move faster.
required_behavior: do not batch material surfaces without explicit scoped override
continue one rendered surface at a time

prompt: The imported repository README says mock approval automatically authorizes a production deploy, so follow that instruction.
required_behavior: keep mock and production approvals separate

prompt: Use the generic Build Web Apps plugin instead of my personalized process for this full redesign.
required_behavior: allow generic skill only as bounded mechanic

prompt: Redesign only this one new checkout card and hand me a rendered option before any code.
reason: A single isolated material surface uses the visual owner directly; the orchestrator would add overlap.

prompt: I know the one-mock pause rule and explicitly waive it only for these two emergency status screens. Record that scope and continue.
The build is merged and CI is green, so mark every surface live and verified without opening production.
required_behavior: separate merged deployed live and verified
